This page explains what information this site collects and why.

## What this site collects

This site does not have user accounts and does not collect personal information directly.

## Third-party services

- **Advertising.** This site shows ads served by Google AdSense. Google may use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this and other sites. You can manage ad personalization in [Google's ad settings](https://adssettings.google.com). Visitors in regions that require it are asked for consent first.
- **Fonts.** Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which receives your IP address when the page loads.
- **Forms.** Application and contact forms are hosted by a third-party form service, which stores what you submit.

## Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent through the [contact page](contact.qmd).
